subject: Intended update to dartR 1.5.5 - BETA test wanted

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: Intended update to dartR 1.5.5 - BETA test wanted
parts:
HI,

we are about to update to a new version on CRAN in the coming year. This version has quite a number of new functions and before we update we would like to ask some of you to play betatester (if you have time and or want to use the new functions/features).

Attached here is a short update on the main new functions and other features.

It would be great if some of you could have a go and try the new version.

You will find howto install the new version within the document.

In case you want to go back to the previous version simple reinstall the cran (1.11.1) or current github version (1.3.5)


Errors/Comments please post here at the google group.

Thanks in advance,

Bernd & Arthur


PS there is also now a gl2related function but it is not fully tested and seems not to work all the time for all estimators....(see the thread in the google group on Coancestry)

Cheers,
Rafael

HI,

we are about to update to a new version on CRAN in the coming year. This version has quite a number of new functions and before we update we would like to ask some of you to play betatester (if you have time and or want to use the new functions/features).

Attached here is a short update on the main new functions and other features.

It would be great if some of you could have a go and try the new version.

You will find howto install the new version within the document.

In case you want to go back to the previous version simple reinstall the cran (1.11.1) or current github version (1.3.5)


Errors/Comments please post here at the google group.

Thanks in advance,

Bernd & Arthur


PS there is also now a gl2related function but it is not fully tested and seems not to work all the time for all estimators....(see the thread in the google group on Coancestry)
